### STEP 1: Initialization

**Master Directory Structure & Vite Setup Strategy**

```
/workbench/
├── index.html
├── package.json
├── vite.config.js
├── shared/
│   ├── input/
│   │   └── InputController.js       # Unified Keyboard (WASD/Arrows) + Gamepad API controller
│   ├── physics/
│   │   └── PhysicsEngine.js         # Vanilla physics & collision mechanics (AABB, circle-rectangle, etc.)
│   ├── vfx/
│   │   ├── ParticleManager.js       # Centralized particle manager with hard cap of 500 active particles
│   │   ├── CameraShake.js           # Trauma-based camera shake system with decaying intensity
│   │   ├── HitStop.js               # Frame-freeze / timescale dilation on heavy impacts
│   │   ├── MotionTrail.js           # Motion trails for fast-moving objects
│   │   ├── ShockwaveRing.js         # Expanding emissive rings on impacts/deaths
│   │   └── FloatingText.js          # Dynamic 3D/HTML floating score text system
│   ├── rendering/
│   │   ├── PostProcessor.js         # EffectComposer with UnrealBloomPass for neon glow
│   │   └── ProceduralAssets.js      # Canvas API textures, Simplex noise/sine wave geometry displacement
│   ├── audio/
│   │   └── WebAudioSynth.js         # Web Audio API synthesized SFX and music generation
│   └── pool/
│       ├── ObjectPool.js            # Generic object pooling utility for entities/projectiles/particles
│       ├── ProjectilePool.js        # Projectile-specific object pool
│       └── EntityPool.js            # Entity-specific object pool
├── games/
│   └── [GameName]/                  # Isolated game directory (e.g., Asteroids, Space_Invaders)
│       ├── Game.js                  # Main game loop, state management, and core logic
│       ├── Entities.js              # Game-specific entity classes and behaviors
│       ├── Rendering.js             # Game-specific Three.js scene setup and InstancedMesh usage
│       └── UI.css                   # Glassmorphism UI styles with vibrant neon glowing accents
```

**Vite Setup Strategy:**
- `vite.config.js` configured for ES modules with appropriate resolve aliases for the `shared/` and `games/[GameName]/` directories.
- `index.html` serves as the single entry point, loading the Three.js library via ES module imports and initializing the game container with a canvas element and HTML/CSS overlay containers for the Glassmorphism UI.
